# Health record import fixtures

All data in this directory is synthetic. No file describes a real person.

- `mychart_like_ccd.xml` is written by hand (in the healthrecord-bridge project)
  to mimic the shape of an Epic MyChart "Download my record" Continuity of Care
  Document: allergies with reactions and severity, medication orders with route
  and frequency, lab results with reference ranges and interpretation codes,
  encounters with locations, immunizations with lot numbers and a refusal, and a
  Social History section. Every name, identifier, address and value is fictional.
- `synthea_letha284_haag279.xml` is a C-CDA R2.1 document generated by
  [Synthea](https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea) (synthetichealth/synthea,
  Apache License 2.0), taken unmodified from the published sample set
  `synthea_sample_data_ccda_sep2019.zip`. The patient, providers, identifiers and
  clinical events are produced by Synthea's simulation and are not derived from
  any real record.
